resources.string: This card has not been issued yet.
This card has no PIN set up yet. Ask the issuer to finish issuing it.
This card has been terminated and can no longer be used.
This card needs its PIN to sign in. Enter the card PIN and tap again.
The card balance is too low for this amount.
The card refused this transfer as already applied or out of date.
The card refused this transfer: its counter is too far ahead.
The card refused this transfer: its send sequence is out of order.
This card runs applet %1$s, which is too old for this app (0.2 or newer is required).
The card moved away. Hold it still against the phone and tap again.
The request could not be sent to the card: %1$s
No Impala applet for this network answered. This may be a card for another network, not an Impala card, or an unsupported applet version.
Read-only session refused %1$s. Nothing was sent to the card.
The card refused to sign the server\'s sign-in challenge. It signs only a challenge issued for its own key.
